definitions.gloss: to collect forcibly; to demand payment; to dun
definitions.explanation: To press someone to pay a debt, tax, or other obligation, often in an aggressive or persistent manner.

definitions.gloss: to single out; to make special mention of; to highlight
definitions.explanation: To pick out and give special attention or emphasis to something. Often used in negative constructions meaning there is nothing worth singling out.

definitions.gloss: to promote; to give a position to; to elevate
definitions.explanation: To appoint or promote someone to a position, especially someone of lower status.

notes:
Compound verb of ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) + ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to set up, establish). The three senses are quite distinct in usage.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (debt collection) is common in financial and legal contexts, and in stories about loan sharks. Sense 2 is very frequently used in the adverbial form {取|と}り{立|た}てて, almost always in negative constructions ({取|と}り{立|た}てて～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ = "nothing particularly..."). Sense 3 (promote) has a somewhat historical or literary feel and implies elevating someone from a lower position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to collect a debt
- {取|と}り{立|た}てて～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — nothing particularly...
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to promote talent
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{取|と}り{立|た}てる — to collect harshly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徴収|ちょうしゅう}→徴収：16563_choushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to collect, levy (official/institutional, more neutral)
- ⟦{催促|さいそく}する→催促する：26806_saisokusuru⟧ — to press, urge (less aggressive than {取|と}り{立|た}てる)
- ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to promote, single out for advancement (more formal, positive nuance)
